scope: Home, durable Notes create/read and Visual catalog through the preserved DESERT components. Recovery checkpoint, not a production or all-platform release.

sdk.access: Private SDK; authorized checkout required. This tag does not publish or relicense DESERT.

verification.scope: Exact visual parity compares identical Landmarks reference data on the old and new SDK builds. VOID has its own labels and original SDK illustration; its content is not claimed pixel-identical to Landmarks.

recovery: Check out this tag in a new VOID directory and the exact SDK commit above in a sibling desert directory. Leave existing stores and approved previews untouched.
Use Node v24.16.0, PostgreSQL tools and locked dependencies in both repositories.
Run npm run check, then node scripts/build-web.ts build/void-n1-restored using a fresh build destination.
Run node scripts/run-local.ts build/void-n1-restored .local/void-n1-restored 4401, substituting an available local port if needed.
Use the private one-use launch URL generated locally; never commit it. Restore an existing store only by an explicit compatible-store selection, never by resetting its contract or identity.
preserved: Original local identity and PostgreSQL store
Current local preview and frozen build
excludedFromPublication: Local PostgreSQL data and browser state
Private SDK source and Apple sample media
outstanding: Safe editing and remaining Notes scope
General capability-module integration and renderer ownership audit
Production onboarding/identity, MCP/API transports and native releases
releasePolicy: Development branch and annotated recovery tag only. No main push, binary upload, deployment or native release.
